slides.text: THIS BOX WAS SOLD ON EBAY... AND NOBODY KEEPS IT
2003. Portland, Oregon. A man named Kevin Mannis lists an old wine cabinet on eBay.
His listing says it came from an estate sale... and that it held a dybbuk, a restless spirit from Jewish folklore.
He wrote about nightmares, strange smells, and his mother having a stroke the day she saw it.
The next buyer, a college student, reportedly got rid of it within months.
Then a museum director, Jason Haxton, won it for $280. He reported illness and nightmares... and wrote a whole book about it.
Its story inspired the 2012 horror movie The Possession.
Today it sits in Zak Bagans' Haunted Museum in Las Vegas. Fans blamed Post Malone's run of bad luck on touching it.
The twist: in 2021, Kevin Mannis said he made the whole story up. People still won't touch it.
